remedies.name_am: የእንጨት አመድ እና ነጭ ሽንኩርት መርጫ

remedies.mechanism: Wood ash alters leaf surface pH to inhibit fungal spore germination, while garlic acts as a natural antimicrobial agent.
remedies.mechanism_am: የእንጨት አመድ የቅጠል ገጽ pH በመቀየር የፈንገስ ስፖሮ መብቀልን ይከላከላል፤ ነጭ ሽንኩርት እንደ ተፈጥሯዊ ፀረ-ማይክሮብ ይሰራል።

remedies.name: Livestock Urine & Soap (Endod) Treatment

remedies.mechanism_am: የተቀላቀለ የከብት/በሬ ሽንት ዩሪያ እና አሞኒያ ውህዶችን ይይዛል፤ የአፈር በሽታ አምጪዎችን ያጭዳል እና የስር እድገትን ያነቃቃል።

remedies.name: Tool Flaming (Macha Sanitation)

remedies.mechanism: Heat-sterilizing harvesting knives in open fire destroys bacterial slime and fungal spores between plants, cutting transmission rates by over 35%.

remedies.name: Deep Pit Isolation & Burial
remedies.targets: Systemic bacterial infections, wilts, and soil-borne fungi.
remedies.targets_am: የስርዓት ባክቴሪያ ኢንፌክሽኖች፣ ዊልቶች እና በአፈር የሚተላለፉ ፈንገሶች።
remedies.mechanism: Digging out infected plants and burying them under 50+ cm of soil starves soil-borne pathogens and prevents spore transmission by wind or rain.
remedies.mechanism_am: የተያዙ ተክሎችን ቆፍረው ከ50+ ሳ.ሜ አፈር ስር መቅበር የአፈር በሽታ አምጪዎችን ያራባል እና በነፋስ/ዝናብ ስርጭትን ይከላከላል።

remedies.name: Intercropping & Shade Management

remedies.targets_am: የቡና ፍሬ በሽታ፣ ቅጠል ዝገት፣ የባቄላ ዝገት እና የበቆሎ ቅጠል በሽታዎች።

remedies.mechanism: A simple mix of copper sulfate and slaked lime coats leaves with a protective fungicide film — one of the oldest and most effective home sprays.

diseases.transmission_am: በዛፉ ላይ ካሉ የተያዙ ፍሬዎች በዝናብ መርጨት፤ በዋና ዝናብ ወቅት ይስፋፋል።
diseases.season: Main rainy season (May–August) when berries are green.
